title: Question 11
passage:
What if the sample case won't fit in the taxi trunk?
A. It's the case with the blue tag. B. The driver can wait by the loading door. C. Then we'll request a larger vehicle.
passageZh:
萬一裝樣品的箱子放不進計程車後車廂，怎麼辦？
A. 是貼著藍色標籤的那一箱。
B. 司機可以在裝卸區入口等。
C. 那我們就改叫一輛大一點的車。
